title_clean_bertopic: Switching Behavior Analysis of E-Government Application Using the Extended UTAUT Model. To improve population administration services, the government has developed an e-government initiative in the form of a Digital Population Identity IKD application. IKD is a solution to the process of making a physical E-KTP Electronic Population Card which takes quite a long time. Although the government has set a target of 25 of E-KTP holders activating IKD in 2023, the realization is only around 3.3 who have activated it. Based on these conditions, it is necessary to examine the factors that influence IKD application users to switch from E-KTP to the IKD application using the Extended Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology UTAUT model. The population of this study was IKD application users in Java, with a total of 406 respondents selected through a proportional stratified random samplingtechnique. Data analysis was carried out using the PLS-SEM approach with SmartPLS version 4.1. The results of the study showed six variables that significantly influenced user behaviorto switch from E-KTP to IKD. Namely the variables of performance expectations, social influence, perceived risk, perceived security and privacy, trust, and intention to switch. In contrast, expectations of effort, supportive conditions, and government support did not have a significant effect. The variables of perceived security and privacy showed the highest significance, with a t-test value of 54.339 and a p-value of 0.000,while the variable of government support showed the smallest impact, with a t-test value of 0.354 and a p-value of 0.723. These findings can provide direction for Dukcapil to improve the implementation and increase public acceptance of the IKD application.

title_clean_bertopic: Digital technology in the modern era. The development of digital technology in the last two decades has brought significant transformation in various fields, including theology. This research aims to analyze forms of use of digital technology in the study, practice and dissemination of information about theological doctrines, as well as their implications for the development of spirituality and religious education. Through a descriptive qualitative approach based on literature study, this research identifies that digital technology, such as online learning platforms, digital Bible applications, artificial intelligence AI , and social media, provides access to broader theological knowledge, strengthens faith community interactions, and facilitates more flexible learning models. However, the author also highlights emerging challenges, including the risk of theological misinformation, reduced or even lost depth of spiritual reflection, and over-reliance on technology. This makes the author interested in discussing the topic of the role of digital technology in the era of modern theology. The results of this research show that the use of digital technology in modern theology brings great opportunities for the development of knowledge and practice of faith, but still requires a critical and ethical approach to remain in harmony with correct theological foundations.

The public complaint service system is an important means for the city government to receive, process and follow up on various citizen complaints. However, the increasing volume of complaint data in the city of Surabaya has become a challenge due to less effective manual management. In-depth analysis of complaint data is needed to understand public opinion on service quality. This research aims to carry out aspect-based sentiment analysis of complaint data. The research was conducted using the Latent Dirichlet Allocation LDA method to identify the main aspects of complaints and using Multinomial Naive Bayes MNB to classify sentiment. The data used consists of 10,847 complaints collected via the WargaKu application and Media Center throughout 2023. The LDA method succeeded in identifying 17 main topics, including administration, infrastructure and public information. Furthermore, the MNB Model achieved 80 accuracy after applying resampling, proving its reliability in sentiment classification. The research results provide relevant insights to help city governments prioritize improvements on key issues and offer approaches that similar complaint systems can adopt

In the midst of rapid advances in technology and internet use, the National Narcotics Agency BNN as a government agency has built a website for the purposes of disseminating information and accelerating communication for the wider community. This research focuses on evaluating and improving the user interface of the official BNN website using Usability Testing and the Human-Centered Design HCD approach. HCD is an approach to developing interactive systems with the aim of making the system usable and useful. Usability testing is the process of testing a website to determine ease of use by users. The research stages start from user identification, user needs analysis, initial design usability testing evaluation, solution design creation, and solution design usability testing evaluation. title_clean_bertopic: Behavioral intention analysis of distance education system using the innovation diffusion theory and technology acceptance model. The Distance Education System DES is a learning system by using online application facilities through internet that rapidly adopted in the education sector. However, there has been many obstacles and problems that hinder learning activities. It has been implemented in all level of education in Indonesia even more during pandemic Covid-19. DES is one of the innovations that have been adopted in education sector, hence its kind of technology can influence the intention of learning. The purpose of this study is to measure an individual perception on behavioural intention to use of Distance Education Systems DES in the province of DKI Jakarta area. Researchers used a combination of the Technology Acceptance Model TAM and Innovation Diffusion Theory IDT research models. The sampling technique used is purposive sampling, which only selects the students of Islamic Junior high school Madrasah Aliyah Negeri MAN in the province of DKI Jakarta area. The data analysis method used is PLS-SEM with the product software of SmartPLS 3.3.3. The results of the study indicate that 8 out of 13 hypotheses are accepted. The variable that has the greatest influence on behavioural intention to use is compatibility mediated by perceived usefulness. The results found that three IDT variables relative advantages, complexity, trialability have a significant effect on the perceived usefulness variable, then lead to it has a significant relationship on behavioral intention to use. In addition, the two of IDT variable namely compatibility and trialability have significant effect on the perceived ease of use then it has a significant effect on behavioral intention to use. The study found that the behavioural intention to use of DES influenced by the innovation characteristics IDT and mediated by the characteristics of technology itself TAM .

title_clean_bertopic: Ethical Analysis of Consumer Data Use in E-Commerce Platforms. The growth of e-commerce platforms in Indonesia is encouraging the collection of consumer data on an unprecedented scale, but management practices are not yet fully ethical. The main problem that arises is the gap between the ethical principles of data use that should be applied and actual practice in the field, which is exacerbated by weak regulatory enforcement and low consumer awareness of their personal rights. This research aims to analyze the ethical principles of using consumer data in e-commerce platforms, examine the regulatory framework that regulates it and the challenges of its implementation, and identify the relationship between ethical data practices and consumer trust. The method used is a literature review with a descriptive qualitative approach. A total of 21 scientific journal articles published between 2022 and 2026 were thematically analyzed into five main themes ethical use of consumer data, privacy protection and regulation, data misuse and leakage, consumer trust, and the role of technology and information systems. The results of the study show that the principles of transparency and informed consent are still treated as formalities by many platforms, rather than as substantive ethical commitments. The Personal Data Protection Law of 2022 is an important regulatory milestone, but its implementation is still hampered by weak law enforcement and low consumer digital literacy. The 2020 Tokopedia data leak case which exposed more than 91 million accounts proves that the company s ethical negligence has a direct impact on consumer trust. This research concludes that ethical data governance requires integration between internal company commitment, strengthening regulations, adopting data protection technologies such as blockchain and privacy by design, and simultaneously increasing consumer digital literacy.

title_clean_bertopic: Systematic Literature Review of the Use of the Internet of Things IoT in the Health Sector. Currently the Internet of Things IoT is growing rapidly. With its sophisticated technology, IoT is able to provide various positive impacts, such as efficiency, effectiveness and speed in carrying out certain tasks, especially in the health sector. The existence of IoT in the health sector is very important in monitoring patient conditions quickly and practically. The large amount of research on the use of IoT in the health sector can help researchers or related parties in developing IoT in the medical world. Therefore, a literature review is needed regarding the use of IoT in the health sector so that information can be classified systematically. title_clean_bertopic: Evaluation of Digital Sociology on Student Salaf and Modern Islamic Boarding Schools. The current use of digital technology has a lot of influence on human life, especially human sociological aspects, such as patterns of interaction, knitting relationships between individuals, patterns of social behavior relationships, individual attitudes and actions, and so on. The purpose of this research is to find out the digital technology that is in demand and the most widely used by students in modern and salaf Islamic boarding schools and to find out how the influence of digital technology on the social relations of students women with the internal and external environment of the Islamic boarding school. The research was carried out using a quantitative survey and correlational approach to determine the influence of the intensity of use of social media Youtube, Whatsapp, Instagram on social skills in salaf and modern Islamic boarding school students. The sampling technique was random sampling at three Salaf and modern Islamic boarding schools with a sample size of 204. The results of the validity and reliability tests obtained Cronbach s alpha values above 0.6, indicating that the instruments used in the research were valid and reliable. The data analysis technique was carried out using SEM PLS SmartPLS. The results of the research are that there is a relationship between the intensity and duration of social media use by students in Salaf and modern Islamic boarding schools and their level of social skills. This shows that social media usage patterns can influence their ability to interact socially, both positively and negatively.

title_clean_bertopic: Student perceptions of user satisfaction and user loyalty of website based e-learning. This paper discusses the importance of information technology development in facilitating human life through website-based e-learning. E-learning accelerates the dissemination of knowledge, particularly during the Covid-19 pandemic when online learning surged. However, users encounter challenges, such as unclear task instructions and platform errors. This research aims to enhance the quality of e-learning services by analyzing students perceptions of user satisfaction and loyalty on three major e-learning platforms in Indonesia. The study employs the EUCS model augmented with System Quality dimensions. Respondents are middle and high school students in DKI Jakarta who have used one of the e-learning platforms. The results from 209 respondents indicate high user satisfaction, scoring 85.93, and a high level of user loyalty, scoring 84.69. Factors such as Content, Format, Ease of use, Timeliness, Instructor quality, and Course Materials show a positive relationship with user satisfaction, with Course Materials being the most influential. However, hypotheses regarding Accuracy, Administrative and support service quality, and Security and privacy did not prove to have a significant impact. This research is expected to expand the understanding of factors influencing user satisfaction and loyalty in website-based e-learning and provide guidance for improving the quality of e-learning to enhance student satisfaction and loyalty.

Advances in digital transformation have had an impact on the complexity of decision-making processes in various sectors, especially with the increasing volume of large and varied data. In this context, efficient tools are needed to evaluate multi-criteria alternatives objectively. Simple Additive Weighting SAW has emerged as one of the methods that is widely used in Decision Support Systems DSS . However, systematic studies discussing the development and application of this method in various contexts are still very limited. This research aims to conduct a Systematic Literature Review SLR on the development of SAW-based SPK with a focus on identifying application platforms, design methods and benefits of implementation. In this research, the Systematic Literature Review method was used with an approach that follows Kitchenham s guidelines. The research results show that web-based platforms dominate DSS development because of their flexibility, ease of access, and ability to support real-time decision making. In addition, the Prototyping design method is often used because it allows dynamic adjustment of the system to user needs. The application of the SAW method has consistently been proven to increase accuracy, time efficiency, transparency and user confidence in the decision-making process.

While some research has been carry out on ITG in general, there is still very little scientific understanding of Effective ITG in the context of Higher Education Institutions HEI . To gain the effectiveness of IT governance in HEIs need to follow the IT governance mechanisms that provide the set of process and procedures which is in line with the strategic alignment between IT and business. In essence, Effective IT governance will guarantee alignment between IT and the business goals. Organizations with vain IT governance will hurt due to poor performance of IT resources such as inefficient operating costs, inaccurate information quality, and even the decease of its IT department. This paper offer the effective of IT governance evaluation model that may can be used by organizational management in the HEI in particular. Furthermore, this study identifies the factors that contribute to effective IT governance based on past literatures on this domain. In meeting the needs of consumers, a plan is needed in production so that there is no shortage of raw materials and the production process does not stop. Grain is an agricultural commodity whose demand and production levels occasionally increase. We can see that until now, our country, Indonesia, still imports rice from other countries, where rice is the main production product produced from grain. The problem can be solved with the Lot sizing method used in this study, which is used to determine the size of the order quantity. title_clean_bertopic: Sharia Banking Information System. This research reviews Digital Transformation in Sharia Banking Information Systems. This research aims to explore the challenges and opportunities faced by Islamic financial institutions in adopting digital transformation, with a focus on the social and economic impacts on Muslim communities. The methodology used is a qualitative descriptive approach through literature study to collect and analyze data from various trusted sources, which involves analysis of literature related to the development of information technology-based sharia banking. The results show that the digitalization of Islamic banking has brought significant changes in the operations of financial institutions, with an emphasis on fairness and profits in financial transactions. In addition, this transformation improves customer experience through personalization of services, expanding financial inclusion and increasing public financial literacy which in turn encourages active participation in the sharia financial system. This research aims to examine the digital marketing information system strategy implemented by CV. AUFCO in developing their electronic trading business by implementing the SOSTAC method. The SOSTAC method is used as a guideline for developing and implementing digital marketing strategies, which include the stages of Specification, Objectives, Strategy, Tactics, Action and Control. This research uses a descriptive qualitative approach by collecting primary data through in-depth interviews with related parties at AUFCO. The research results reveal that AUFCO has succeeded in implementing effective digital marketing strategies to increase revenue, expand markets and increase customer satisfaction. The use of SOSTAC helps AUFCO in formulating targeted business objectives, determining the right target market, and developing efficient marketing tactics. Evaluation of strategy implementation shows that AUFCO has succeeded in achieving most of the targets set, although there are still obstacles in facing tight business competition and changes in unstable economic conditions. This research contributes ideas in deepening understanding of the application of SOSTAC in the context of electronic commerce, as well as providing suggestions for other business actors who are interested in adopting a similar strategy.

PikApp Indonesia is one of the start-ups in Indonesia which operates in the information technology sector which supports Food and Beverage F B business owners or MSMEs by offering technological features, one of which is a business website which contains a digital menu and can be accessed by scanning the QR Code provided. This feature offers convenience for consumers and merchants themselves. Usability testing carried out in this research aims to determine consumer assessments of the digital business website menus offered and find out what problems are often encountered when accessing the website. Usability testing is carried out using the Nielsen Attributes of Usability NAU questionnaire which contains five criteria or factors, namely learnability, memorability, efficiency, errors, and satisfaction. title_clean_bertopic: The Impact of Technological Readiness Factors on User Satisfaction in The Indonesian Local Government Employee Service System. User satisfaction within a system comes to fruition when their initial expectations align with the system s actual performance and user experiences. This alignment underscores the significance of assessing technological preparedness and potential health risks to measure user contentment. This study addresses a pivotal concern related to a database error, leading to system inaccessibility and redundant performance reporting within the Indonesian Local Government Personnel Service System. The primary objective of this research is to evaluate the degree of perceived user satisfaction and the influencing factors within this context. The assessment focuses on the interplay of technological readiness and user health risks. This study employs a quantitative research approach and a purposive sampling method. The research integrates the Expectation Confirmation Model and Technology Readiness Index 2.0, incorporating a novel variable known as perceived susceptibility. The findings underscore a significant majority of respondents, approximately 96 , expressing satisfaction. Critical determinants of system user satisfaction are identified as perceived usefulness and confirmation. The implications of this research extend to providing insights into enhancing technological readiness to elevate user satisfaction levels within the Indonesian Local Government Personnel Service System. In addition, the results of this study serve as a reference for subsequent research to dig deeper into the subjects explored in this research.

title_clean_bertopic: Implementation of server consolidation method on a data center by using virtualization technique a case study. Data center is a place where data and applications placed and run. The more vary application run, the more server types needed. There are several implications when data center encounter server flood, including more electrical energy must be provided. title_clean_bertopic: Utilization of the Hot-Fit Model to Measure the Success of Information Systems a Literature Review. The Human-Organization-Technology Fit HOTFit Model has been widely used in evaluating the success of information system IS implementation and adoption across various sectors. This research aims to systematically review ten scientific journal articles that utilized the HOT-Fit model in diverse contexts, such as hospitals, government, industry, and education. Employing a Systematic Literature Review SLR approach, this article identifies trends, gaps, and contributions of the HOT-Fit model in supporting the evaluation and decisionmaking related to information systems. The analysis results indicate that human and organizational factors often serve as key determinants of IS success. This research also recommends integrating HOT-Fit with other evaluation methods to enhance the accuracy of evaluation results.

title_clean_bertopic: Factors Influencing the Continuance Intention of Telemedicine Application Usage Using the Extended Expectation Confirmation Model EECM . Telemedicine services have grown rapidly alongside advances in information technology and the increasing need for convenient and fast access to healthcare services. Telemedicine enables users to conduct online medical consultations without physically visiting healthcare facilities. Halodoc is one of the most popular telemedicine platforms in Indonesia, offering various digital health services such as doctor consultations, medication purchases, and laboratory testing. However, user retention remains a challenge, as not all users continue using the application in the long term. This study aims to test and develop the Expectation Confirmation Model ECM by adding two external variables service quality and self-efficacy to explain users continuance intention in using the Halodoc application. A quantitative approach was employed using a survey method with questionnaires. A sample of 209 respondents was selected through non-probability sampling with a purposive sampling approach, focusing on active Halodoc users in the Jabodetabek area. Data analysis was conducted using PLS-SEM with the SmartPLS software. The results show that the Extended Expectation Confirmation Model EECM used in this study is valid and effective in explaining the continuance usage of the Halodoc application. The variables of perceived usefulness, satisfaction, service quality, and self-efficacy significantly influence continuance use intention, with service quality being the most dominant variable. The study proposed nine hypotheses, of which seven were accepted and two rejected. The rejected hypotheses were the effects of confirmation on satisfaction and service quality on satisfaction, which were found to be insignificant due to t-statistic values below the threshold. These findings are expected to serve as a reference for future studies on the adoption of telemedicine health service technologies.

Based on these findings, the researcher conducted a study to design the UI UX of the bizmetch application to meet user needs. The method used is Lean UX. title_clean_bertopic: Fuzzy Analytical Hierarchy Process Approach in Coffee Shop Location Decision Support Systems. One of the main challenges in distributing zakat is the limited funds available compared to the number of applications for assistance which continues to increase. This condition causes institutions such as BAZNAS to carry out strict selection and determine priorities for aid recipients fairly. In an effort to answer these problems, this research developed a Decision Support System DSS using a combination of Random Forest and Fuzzy Analytical Hierarchy Process F-AHP methods. The Random Forest method is used to classify the eligibility of prospective zakat recipients based on five main criteria, namely income, number of dependents, residence status, history of receiving aid, and nominal application. Meanwhile, the Fuzzy Analytical Hierarchy Process F-AHP is used to determine the priority level of candidates who have been declared eligible. This research uses data from BAZNAS Bandung City, which was collected through observation and interviews. The evaluation results show that the Random Forest model built has an accuracy rate of 88.98 , with precision and recall each above 93 , indicating high classification performance. Furthermore, the Fuzzy Analytical Hierarchy Process F-AHP weighting process produces a dominant weight for the income criterion of 0.408, followed by residence status and number of dependents. This system has succeeded in assisting the selection and ranking process of prospective zakat recipients objectively, efficiently and transparently. With this approach, it is hoped that zakat managers can optimize zakat distribution according to priorities to those in need.
